title: पञ्चचत्वारिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 45 · Dhritarashtra yields to his son

summary.en: Shakuni tells Dhritarashtra of Duryodhana's grief, and Duryodhana pours out his envy of the Pandavas' splendour. Dhritarashtra, though Vidura warns him, agrees to a dice game and orders a new hall built, and Vidura goes to Bhishma in distress.
summary.kn: ದುರ್ಯೋಧನನ ದುಃಖವನ್ನು ಶಕುನಿ ಧೃತರಾಷ್ಟ್ರನಿಗೆ ತಿಳಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ, ದುರ್ಯೋಧನನು ಪಾಂಡವರ ವೈಭವದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ತನ್ನ ಅಸೂಯೆಯನ್ನು ತೋಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ವಿದುರನು ಎಚ್ಚರಿಸಿದರೂ ಧೃತರಾಷ್ಟ್ರನು ಜೂಜಿಗೆ ಒಪ್ಪಿ ಹೊಸ ಸಭೆ ಕಟ್ಟಲು ಆಜ್ಞಾಪಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ವಿದುರನು ದುಃಖದಿಂದ ಭೀಷ್ಮನಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: शकुनि धृतराष्ट्र को दुर्योधन के दुःख की बात बताता है, और दुर्योधन पाण्डवों के वैभव पर अपनी ईर्ष्या उँडेल देता है। विदुर की चेतावनी के बावजूद धृतराष्ट्र द्यूत के लिए सहमत होकर नई सभा बनाने का आदेश देते हैं, और विदुर दुःखी होकर भीष्म के पास जाते हैं।
summary.te: దుర్యోధనుని దుఃఖాన్ని శకుని ధృతరాష్ట్రునికి చెబుతాడు, దుర్యోధనుడు పాండవుల వైభవంపై తన అసూయను వెళ్లగక్కుతాడు. విదురుడు హెచ్చరించినా ధృతరాష్ట్రుడు జూదానికి అంగీకరించి కొత్త సభ నిర్మించమని ఆజ్ఞాపిస్తాడు; విదురుడు దుఃఖంతో భీష్ముని వద్దకు వెళ్తాడు.
summary.ta: துரியோதனனின் துயரத்தை ஶகுனி திருதராஷ்டிரனிடம் சொல்ல, துரியோதனன் பாண்டவர்களின் சிறப்பு மீதான பொறாமையைக் கொட்டுகிறான். விதுரர் எச்சரித்தும் திருதராஷ்டிரன் சூதுக்கு இசைந்து புதிய ஸபை கட்ட ஆணையிட, விதுரர் வருத்தத்துடன் பீஷ்மரிடம் செல்கிறார்.
summary.ml: ദുര്യോധനന്റെ ദുഃഖം ശകുനി ധൃതരാഷ്ട്രരോട് പറയുന്നു; പാണ്ഡവരുടെ പ്രതാപത്തിലുള്ള അസൂയ ദുര്യോധനൻ തുറന്നുപറയുന്നു. വിദുരർ മുന്നറിയിപ്പ് നൽകിയിട്ടും ധൃതരാഷ്ട്രർ ചൂതുകളിക്ക് സമ്മതിക്കുകയും പുതിയ സഭ പണിയാൻ കല്പിക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു; വിദുരർ ദുഃഖത്തോടെ ഭീഷ്മരുടെ അടുത്തേക്ക് പോകുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 2.45; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Apr 19 2006

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
अनुभूय तु राज्ञस्तं राजसूयं महाक्रतुम् ।
युधिष्ठिरस्य नृपतेर्गान्धारीपुत्रसंयुतः ॥

meaning.en: After witnessing King Yudhishthira's great Rajasuya sacrifice, Shakuni, with Gandhari's son,

verses.text:
प्रियकृन्मतमाज्ञाय पूर्वं दुर्योधनस्य तत् ।
प्रज्ञाचक्षुषमासीनं शकुनिः सौबलस्तदा ॥

meaning.en: knowing beforehand Duryodhana's wish and eager to please him, approached the wise king, the one who sees with the eye of insight, as he sat.

verses.text:
दुर्योधनवचः श्रुत्वा धृतराष्ट्रं जनाधिपम् ।
उपगम्य महाप्राज्ञं शकुनिर्वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Having heard Duryodhana's words, Shakuni went to the wise king Dhritarashtra and said:

verses.text:
दुर्योधनो महाराज विवर्णो हरिणः कृशः ।
दीनश्चिन्तापरश्चैव तद्विद्धि भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Shakuni said: Great king, Duryodhana has turned pale, thin and yellow, dejected and absorbed in worry; know that, bull of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
न वै परीक्षसे सम्यगसह्यं शत्रुसंभवम् ।
ज्येष्ठपुत्रस्य शोकं त्वं किमर्थं नावबुध्यसे ॥

meaning.en: You do not properly examine an enemy-born grief that cannot be borne; why do you not understand your eldest son's sorrow?

verses.text: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said:

verses.text:
दुर्योधन कुतोमूलं भृशमार्तोऽसि पुत्रक ।
श्रोतव्यश्चेन्मया सोऽर्थो ब्रूहि मे कुरुनन्दन ॥

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said: Duryodhana, what is the root of this deep distress, son? If it is fit for me to hear, tell me, joy of the Kurus.

verses.text:
अयं त्वां शकुनिः प्राह विवर्णं हरिणं कृशम् ।
चिन्तयंश्च न पश्यामि शोकस्य तव संभवम् ॥

meaning.en: Shakuni here says you are pale, yellow and thin. I think and I do not see any cause of your sorrow.

verses.text:
ऐश्वर्यं हि महत्पुत्र त्वयि सर्वं समर्पितम् ।
भ्रातरः सुहृदश्चैव नाचरन्ति तवाप्रियम् ॥

meaning.en: Son, all this great sovereignty has been handed to you; your brothers and friends do nothing displeasing to you.

verses.text:
आच्छादयसि प्रावारानश्नासि पिशितौदनम् ।
आजानेया वहन्ति त्वां केनासि हरिणः कृशः ॥

meaning.en: You wear fine cloaks, you eat meat and rice, and thoroughbred horses carry you; why are you yellow and thin?

verses.text:
शयनानि महार्हाणि योषितश्च मनोरमाः ।
गुणवन्ति च वेश्मानि विहाराश्च यथासुखम् ॥

meaning.en: You have costly beds, lovely women, fine houses and pleasure grounds as you wish.

verses.text:
देवानामिव ते सर्वं वाचि बद्धं न संशयः ।
स दीन इव दुर्धर्षः कस्माच्छोचसि पुत्रक ॥

meaning.en: Everything, as if for the gods, is bound to your word, no doubt. Why, son, do you grieve as though poor, you who are hard to oppose?

verses.text: दुर्योधन उवाच

meaning.en: Duryodhana said:

verses.text:
अश्नाम्याच्छादये चाहं यथा कुपुरुषस्तथा ।
अमर्षं धारये चोग्रं तितिक्षन्कालपर्ययम् ॥

meaning.en: Duryodhana said: I eat and dress like a worthless man; I bear a fierce anger while enduring the turn of time.

verses.text:
अमर्षणः स्वाः प्रकृतीरभिभूय परे स्थिताः ।
क्लेशान्मुमुक्षुः परजान्स वै पुरुष उच्यते ॥

meaning.en: He is called a man who, intolerant, has mastered his own nature and stands above his rivals, seeking release from the troubles that his enemies cause.

verses.text:
संतोषो वै श्रियं हन्ति अभिमानश्च भारत ।
अनुक्रोशभये चोभे यैर्वृतो नाश्नुते महत् ॥

meaning.en: Contentment destroys prosperity, Bharata, and so do pride, pity and fear; one surrounded by these does not gain greatness.

verses.text:
न मामवति तद्भुक्तं श्रियं दृष्ट्वा युधिष्ठिरे ।
ज्वलन्तीमिव कौन्तेये विवर्णकरणीं मम ॥

meaning.en: What I eat does not nourish me, seeing Yudhishthira's wealth blazing, which makes me pale.

verses.text:
सपत्नानृध्यतोऽऽत्मानं हीयमानं निशाम्य च ।
अदृश्यामपि कौन्तेये स्थितां पश्यन्निवोद्यताम् ।
तस्मादहं विवर्णश्च दीनश्च हरिणः कृशः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing my enemies flourishing and myself declining, and seeing the son of Kunti's unseen fortune as if standing before me, I am therefore pale, dejected, yellow and thin.

verses.text:
अष्टाशीतिसहस्राणि स्नातका गृहमेधिनः ।
त्रिंशद्दासीक एकैको यान्बिभर्ति युधिष्ठिरः ॥

meaning.en: Yudhishthira supports eighty-eight thousand householder snatakas, each with thirty maidservants.

verses.text:
दशान्यानि सहस्राणि नित्यं तत्रान्नमुत्तमम् ।
भुञ्जते रुक्मपात्रीभिर्युधिष्ठिरनिवेशने ॥

meaning.en: In Yudhishthira's house ten thousand others daily eat the finest food from golden dishes.

verses.text:
कदलीमृगमोकानि कृष्णश्यामारुणानि च ।
काम्बोजः प्राहिणोत्तस्मै परार्ध्यानपि कम्बलान् ॥

meaning.en: The Kamboja king sent him plantain-deer hides, black, dark and red, and the costliest blankets.

verses.text:
रथयोषिद्गवाश्वस्य शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ।
त्रिंशतं चोष्ट्रवामीनां शतानि विचरन्त्युत ॥

meaning.en: Chariots, women, cows and horses, hundreds and thousands, and thirty hundreds of she-camels wander there.

verses.text:
पृथग्विधानि रत्नानि पार्थिवाः पृथिवीपते ।
आहरन्क्रतुमुख्येऽस्मिन्कुन्तीपुत्राय भूरिशः ॥

meaning.en: Lord of earth, the kings brought in abundance, to the son of Kunti at that chief of sacrifices, jewels of various kinds.

verses.text:
न क्वचिद्धि मया दृष्टस्तादृशो नैव च श्रुतः ।
यादृग्धनागमो यज्ञे पाण्डुपुत्रस्य धीमतः ॥

meaning.en: I have nowhere seen or heard of such an inflow of wealth as at the sacrifice of wise Pandu's son.

verses.text:
अपर्यन्तं धनौघं तं दृष्ट्वा शत्रोरहं नृप ।
शर्म नैवाधिगच्छामि चिन्तयानोऽनिशं विभो ॥

meaning.en: Seeing that boundless flood of wealth of my enemy, king, I find no peace, lord, thinking of it constantly.

verses.text:
ब्राह्मणा वाटधानाश्च गोमन्तः शतसंघशः ।
त्रैखर्वं बलिमादाय द्वारि तिष्ठन्ति वारिताः ॥

meaning.en: Brahmins, Vatadhanas and cow-keepers in hundreds of crowds stand at the door, held back, bringing tribute of three kharvas.

verses.text:
कमण्डलूनुपादाय जातरूपमयाञ्शुभान् ।
एवं बलिं समादाय प्रवेशं लेभिरे ततः ॥

meaning.en: Taking fine golden water-pots as tribute, they thus gained admittance.

verses.text:
यन्नैव मधु शक्राय धारयन्त्यमरस्त्रियः ।
तदस्मै कांस्यमाहार्षीद्वारुणं कलशोदधिः ॥

meaning.en: The honey that celestial women do not hold for Shakra, the ocean of Varuna's pitchers brought to him in a bronze vessel.

verses.text:
शैक्यं रुक्मसहस्रस्य बहुरत्नविभूषितम् ।
दृष्ट्वा च मम तत्सर्वं ज्वररूपमिवाभवत् ॥

meaning.en: I saw a sling-hung vessel worth a thousand gold pieces, adorned with many gems, and all that became like a fever to me.

verses.text:
गृहीत्वा तत्तु गच्छन्ति समुद्रौ पूर्वदक्षिणौ ।
तथैव पश्चिमं यान्ति गृहीत्वा भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Taking it, they go to the eastern and southern seas; likewise they go west, bull of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
उत्तरं तु न गच्छन्ति विना तात पतत्रिभिः ।
इदं चाद्भुतमत्रासीत्तन्मे निगदतः शृणु ॥

meaning.en: But to the north none go, dear father, except birds. And hear this wonder that happened there, as I tell it.

verses.text:
पूर्णे शतसहस्रे तु विप्राणां परिविष्यताम् ।
स्थापिता तत्र संज्ञाभूच्छङ्खो ध्मायति नित्यशः ॥

meaning.en: When a hundred thousand brahmins had been served, a signal was fixed: a conch was blown there daily.

verses.text:
मुहुर्मुहुः प्रणदतस्तस्य शङ्खस्य भारत ।
उत्तमं शब्दमश्रौषं ततो रोमाणि मेऽहृषन् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing that conch resound again and again, Bharata, a supreme sound, my hair stood on end.

verses.text:
पार्थिवैर्बहुभिः कीर्णमुपस्थानं दिदृक्षुभिः ।
सर्वरत्नान्युपादाय पार्थिवा वै जनेश्वर ॥

meaning.en: The audience hall was crowded with many kings who wished to see; the kings, taking every kind of jewel,

verses.text:
यज्ञे तस्य महाराज पाण्डुपुत्रस्य धीमतः ।
वैश्या इव महीपाला द्विजातिपरिवेषकाः ॥

meaning.en: at the sacrifice of that wise Pandu's son, great king, served the twice-born like Vaishyas.

verses.text:
न सा श्रीर्देवराजस्य यमस्य वरुणस्य वा ।
गुह्यकाधिपतेर्वापि या श्री राजन्युधिष्ठिरे ॥

meaning.en: King, the splendour that is Yudhishthira's is not that of Indra, Yama, Varuna or the lord of the Guhyakas.

verses.text:
तां दृष्ट्वा पाण्डुपुत्रस्य श्रियं परमिकामहम् ।
शान्तिं न परिगच्छामि दह्यमानेन चेतसा ॥

meaning.en: Having seen that supreme prosperity of Pandu's son, I find no peace, my mind burning.

verses.text: शकुनिरुवाच

meaning.en: Shakuni said:

verses.text:
यामेतामुत्तमां लक्ष्मीं दृष्टवानसि पाण्डवे ।
तस्याः प्राप्तावुपायं मे शृणु सत्यपराक्रम ॥

meaning.en: Shakuni said: Hear from me, truly valiant one, the means of getting that supreme glory you have seen in the Pandava.

verses.text:
अहमक्षेष्वभिज्ञातः पृथिव्यामपि भारत ।
हृदयज्ञः पणज्ञश्च विशेषज्ञश्च देवने ॥

meaning.en: I am known for dice on earth too, Bharata; I know the heart, know the stakes and know the fine points of play.

verses.text:
द्यूतप्रियश्च कौन्तेयो न च जानाति देवितुम् ।
आहूतश्चैष्यति व्यक्तं दीव्यावेत्याह्वयस्व तम् ॥

meaning.en: The son of Kunti loves dice but does not know how to play; invited, he will certainly come. Invite him: Let us play.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
एवमुक्तः शकुनिना राजा दुर्योधनस्तदा ।
धृतराष्ट्रमिदं वाक्यमपदान्तरमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: So addressed by Shakuni, King Duryodhana then said to Dhritarashtra, speaking so as to pause between the words:

verses.text:
अयमुत्सहते राजञ्श्रियमाहर्तुमक्षवित् ।
द्यूतेन पाण्डुपुत्रस्य तदनुज्ञातुमर्हसि ॥

meaning.en: Duryodhana said: King, this one skilled at dice is ready to take the Pandava's fortune by gambling; you should give leave.

verses.text: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said:

verses.text:
क्षत्ता मन्त्री महाप्राज्ञः स्थितो यस्यास्मि शासने ।
तेन संगम्य वेत्स्यामि कार्यस्यास्य विनिश्चयम् ॥

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said: Kshatta, the wise minister, at whose direction I stand: having met him, I shall decide this matter.

verses.text:
स हि धर्मं पुरस्कृत्य दीर्घदर्शी परं हितम् ।
उभयोः पक्षयोर्युक्तं वक्ष्यत्यर्थविनिश्चयम् ॥

meaning.en: For he, looking to dharma and far-sighted, will state the decision that is best and fit for both sides.

verses.text: दुर्योधन उवाच

meaning.en: Duryodhana said:

verses.text:
निवर्तयिष्यति त्वासौ यदि क्षत्ता समेष्यति ।
निवृत्ते त्वयि राजेन्द्र मरिष्येऽहमसंशयम् ॥

meaning.en: Duryodhana said: If Kshatta comes, he will turn you back; and if you are turned back, king of kings, I shall surely die.

verses.text:
स मयि त्वं मृते राजन्विदुरेण सुखी भव ।
भोक्ष्यसे पृथिवीं कृत्स्नां किं मया त्वं करिष्यसि ॥

meaning.en: When I am dead, king, be happy with Vidura, you will enjoy the whole earth; what will you do with me?

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
आर्तवाक्यं तु तत्तस्य प्रणयोक्तं निशम्य सः ।
धृतराष्ट्रोऽब्रवीत्प्रेष्यान्दुर्योधनमते स्थितः ॥

meaning.en: Hearing that sorrowful, affectionate speech, Dhritarashtra, bound by Duryodhana's opinion, said to his servants:

verses.text:
स्थूणासहस्रैर्बृहतीं शतद्वारां सभां मम ।
मनोरमां दर्शनीयामाशु कुर्वन्तु शिल्पिनः ॥

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said: Let craftsmen quickly build me a great hall with a thousand pillars and a hundred doors, delightful and splendid to see.

verses.text:
ततः संस्तीर्य रत्नैस्तामक्षानावाप्य सर्वशः ।
सुकृतां सुप्रवेशां च निवेदयत मे शनैः ॥

meaning.en: Then, once it is spread with jewels and fitted out with dice everywhere, well made and easy to enter, report to me quietly.

verses.text:
दुर्योधनस्य शान्त्यर्थमिति निश्चित्य भूमिपः ।
धृतराष्ट्रो महाराज प्राहिणोद्विदुराय वै ॥

meaning.en: Deciding that it was for Duryodhana's peace, King Dhritarashtra, great king, sent a message to Vidura.

verses.text:
अपृष्ट्वा विदुरं ह्यस्य नासीत्कश्चिद्विनिश्चयः ।
द्यूतदोषांश्च जानन्स पुत्रस्नेहादकृष्यत ॥

meaning.en: Without asking Vidura he never made a decision; though he knew the faults of gambling, he was drawn by love for his son.

verses.text:
तच्छ्रुत्वा विदुरो धीमान्कलिद्वारमुपस्थितम् ।
विनाशमुखमुत्पन्नं धृतराष्ट्रमुपाद्रवत् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing that, wise Vidura, knowing the door of Kali had been opened and ruin had arisen, rushed to Dhritarashtra.

verses.text:
सोऽभिगम्य महात्मानं भ्राता भ्रातरमग्रजम् ।
मूर्ध्ना प्रणम्य चरणाविदं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Approaching his great-souled elder brother and bowing his head at his feet, the younger brother said these words:

verses.text:
नाभिनन्दामि ते राजन्व्यवसायमिमं प्रभो ।
पुत्रैर्भेदो यथा न स्याद्द्यूतहेतोस्तथा कुरु ॥

meaning.en: Vidura said: King, lord, I do not approve this decision of yours; act so that no rift arises among your sons because of the dice.

verses.text: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said:

verses.text:
क्षत्तः पुत्रेषु पुत्रैर्मे कलहो न भविष्यति ।
दिवि देवाः प्रसादं नः करिष्यन्ति न संशयः ॥

meaning.en: Kshatta, there will be no quarrel between my sons and the sons of my brother; the gods in heaven will favour us, no doubt.

verses.text:
अशुभं वा शुभं वापि हितं वा यदि वाहितम् ।
प्रवर्ततां सुहृद्द्यूतं दिष्टमेतन्न संशयः ॥

meaning.en: Whether inauspicious or auspicious, helpful or harmful, let the game among friends go on; this is fated, no doubt.

verses.text:
मयि संनिहिते चैव भीष्मे च भरतर्षभे ।
अनयो दैवविहितो न कथंचिद्भविष्यति ॥

meaning.en: With me present, and Bhishma bull of the Bharatas, no misfortune ordained by fate will in any way occur.

verses.text:
गच्छ त्वं रथमास्थाय हयैर्वातसमैर्जवे ।
खाण्डवप्रस्थमद्यैव समानय युधिष्ठिरम् ॥

meaning.en: Mount a chariot with horses swift as the wind and go to Khandavaprastha today, and bring Yudhishthira here.

verses.text:
न वार्यो व्यवसायो मे विदुरैतद्ब्रवीमि ते ।
दैवमेव परं मन्ये येनैतदुपपद्यते ॥

meaning.en: I will not be dissuaded from my decision, Vidura; I tell you this. I consider fate supreme, by which this comes about.

verses.text:
इत्युक्तो विदुरो धीमान्नैतदस्तीति चिन्तयन् ।
आपगेयं महाप्राज्ञमभ्यगच्छत्सुदुःखितः ॥

meaning.en: So addressed, wise Vidura, thinking This should not be, went in great distress to the greatly wise son of Ganga.
